Remark
[Converting between divergence and nondivergence form] ↗ def:divergence-nondivergence-form 1. ch6:6.1-rem-1\group Elliptic PDE

If $a^{ij}\in C^1(\bar U)$, the divergence operator (2) equals \[ (2') \qquad Lu = -\sum _{i,j=1}^n a^{ij}(x)u_{x_ix_j} + \sum _{i=1}^n \tilde b^i(x)u_{x_i} + c(x)u \] with $\tilde b^i := b^i - \sum _{j=1}^n a^{ij}_{x_j}$. Thus the two forms are equivalent when the leading coefficients are $C^1$; divergence form is adapted to energy identities and nondivergence form to pointwise maximum principles.
